commands.name: script-shebang-executable-syntax
commands.run: test -x bin/herdr-zed-attach && head -n 1 bin/herdr-zed-attach | grep -qxF '#!/usr/bin/env bash' && bash -n bin/herdr-zed-attach

commands.name: suite-registered-in-dotfiles-tests
commands.run: grep -qxF 'sh bin/herdr-zed-attach.test.sh' bin/dotfiles-tests && bash bin/dotfiles-tests --list | grep -qF 'bin/herdr-zed-attach.test.sh'

commands.name: link-sh-links-into-home-bin
commands.run: grep -qF 'ln -sf "$DOTFILEDIR"/bin/herdr-zed-attach "$HOME"/bin/herdr-zed-attach' install/common/link.sh && grep -qF 'link.sh links herdr-zed-attach into ~/bin' install/install.test.sh && sh install/install.test.sh

commands.name: readme-zed-terminal-threads-section
commands.run: f="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/zt-section.$$"; awk '/^### Zed Terminal Threads$/{s=1;next} /^### /{if(s)exit} s{print}' README.md > "$f"; if ! test -s "$f"; then rm -f "$f"; exit 1; fi; for k in 'agent: new terminal thread' 'agent::NewTerminalThread' 'herdr-zed-attach' 'terminal_init_command' '--remote-control' 'show-toplevel'; do grep -q -F -- "$k" "$f" || { rm -f "$f"; exit 1; }; done; rm -f "$f"; awk '/^### Remote Access$/{a=NR} /^### Zed Terminal Threads$/{b=NR} /^### Worktree Hydration$/{c=NR} END{exit !(a && b && c && a<b && b<c)}' README.md

commands.name: readme-remote-control-flag
commands.run: ! grep -qF 'claude remote-control' README.md && test "$(grep -cF 'claude --remote-control' README.md)" -ge 2 && grep -qF "'claude --remote-control'" claude/contracts/td-2026-09-05-explore-cloudflared-tunnel-access-remote-access-to-contract.json && ! grep -qF "'claude remote-control'" claude/contracts/td-2026-09-05-explore-cloudflared-tunnel-access-remote-access-to-contract.json
